import HartshorneLib.Chapter4SeparatingFunction
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4FiniteMapP1Existence

/-!
# Finite morphisms realizing separating functions

A separating function on a smooth proper integral curve over a perfect field
extends to a finite dominant morphism to the projective line. The equation at
the generic point retains the same function used in the finite separable
extension of the generated rational subfield.

The construction does not choose a preferred function. Identifying the
generic stalk pullback with the generated subfield, and compatibility with
residues, are subsequent steps.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra

/-- A smooth proper integral curve over a perfect field has a finite dominant
map whose generic coordinate generates a subfield over which the function
field is finite separable. The generic-point equation links the map to the
same separating function appearing in the field-extension assertions. -/
theorem exists_isFinite_toP1_with_separating_function
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
    [IsProper X.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    ∃ (t : X.left.functionField) (π : X.left ⟶ P1 k),
      Transcendental k t ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t}) X.left.functionField ∧
      Module.Finite (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t}) X.left.functionField ∧
      IsFinite π ∧ IsDominant π ∧ π ≫ P1.structureMap k = X.hom ∧
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ π =
        P1.fromSpecChart k (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)) 0 t := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hsep, hfin⟩ := exists_separating_curveFunctionField X
  have hscalar : (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)).hom =
      algebraMap k X.left.functionField := by
    change (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)).hom =
      functionFieldOverAlgebraMap k X.left
    ext r
    simp [Scheme.Hom.structureStalk, functionFieldOverAlgebraMap,
      Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
  have ht' : ∀ P : Polynomial k, P ≠ 0 →
      Polynomial.eval₂ (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)).hom t P ≠ 0 := by
    intro P hP heval
    apply ht
    refine ⟨P, hP, ?_⟩
    simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def, hscalar] using heval
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P1.exists_ne_genericPoint k
  obtain ⟨π, hπfin, hπdom, hπover, hπgen⟩ :=
    exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1_of_transcendental_with_hgen X.hom t ht'
      (fun y hy => P1.isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint k hy) z hz
  exact ⟨t, π, ht, hsep, hfin, hπfin, hπdom, hπover, hπgen⟩

end
end Hartshorne
